title: city_applicable_policies row
description: One row per (city, source_document) pair where the document applies to the city. Derived deterministically from releases/v1/data/registry/source_documents.json and releases/v1/data/registry/local_codes.csv by scripts/v2_derive_applicability.py. Drives the join between extracted findings and city-level alignment scores. Documented as JSON Schema; on disk the artifact is a CSV with these columns.

city_code.description: 5-digit commune_code_2018 from local_codes.csv. Stable join key for cities.

region_code.description: 2-digit Chile region code, derived from the city. 00 reserved for national scope and never appears on a city row.

city_name.description: Human-readable commune name from local_codes.csv. Reference only.

document_status.description: Copied from source_documents.json. Placeholder rows are excluded from the derived CSV; the field is included here for downstream filtering on draft/consultation.

applicability_type.description: Why this document applies to this city. Drives the proximity weight.

proximity_weight_base.description: Base weight from the proximity table in scoring_rubric.md, before status penalty.

status_multiplier.description: 1.0 for final, 0.7 for draft/consultation/portal_only/flipbook_only. Documents with status=placeholder are excluded entirely.

proximity_weight.description: Final weight applied at scoring time: proximity_weight_base * status_multiplier.

applicability_reason.description: Short human-readable explanation. Example: 'national framework applies to all cities' or 'city in region 06'.

review_priority.description: Copied from source_documents.json. low-priority docs (PRAS env-programs) are excluded by default; set --include-low-priority on the deriver to keep them.

rubric_version.description: Version of scoring_rubric.md used to set proximity_weight_base. Stored on every row so a downstream consumer can detect rubric drift.
